entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: Daughter of the warlord Konda who seeks to stop the war with the spirit realm.

entities.name: Lord Konda
entities.description: Warlord and father of Michiko, distant at her birth.

entities.name: Lady Pearl-Ear
entities.description: Kitsune who informs Konda of Michiko's birth; her native village is in the kitsune lands.

entities.name: Sharp-Ear
entities.description: Lady Pearl-Ear's brother who tricks the group into the kitsune village.

entities.name: Choryu
entities.description: Michiko's mage friend who killed Kobo and is sent flying by Toshi.

entities.name: Riko
entities.description: Friend of Michiko.

entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: A thief and black magic user hunted by the soratami, who becomes tied to Michiko.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Ogre sage of Shinka consulted by Toshi.

entities.name: Kobo
entities.description: Hidetsugu's apprentice, a Hyozan Reckoner killed by Choryu.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: Kami who offers Toshi her powers if he becomes her acolyte.

entities.name: Myojin of Life's Web
entities.description: Myojin who the orochi planned to summon with a sacrifice of Michiko; unsummoned by Toshi.

entities.name: Mochi
aliases: Smiling Kami of the Crescent Moon
entities.description: Kami who greets Toshi in the cave.

entities.name: orochi
entities.description: Snake folk with a strong connection to the spirit world.

entities.name: kitsune
entities.description: Fox folk of Lady Pearl-Ear's village.

entities.name: soratami
entities.description: Moon folk who chase Toshi to silence him.

entities.name: nezumi
entities.description: Rat folk gang with a deal with the soratami.

entities.name: Eiganjo Castle
entities.description: Konda's fortress that Michiko must escape.

entities.name: Minamo School
entities.description: School Michiko plans to go to.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: Forest where the groups meet and the orochi attack.

entities.name: Shinka
entities.description: Location of Hidetsugu's hut.

entities.name: Numai swamps
entities.description: Swamps where Toshi follows the nezumi.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane of mysticism and honor at war with the spirit realm.

events.summary: On the night of Michiko's birth, Lady Pearl-Ear informs Lord Konda, who seems uninterested.
events.quote: The story starts on the night of Michiko's birth.

events.summary: Years later, Michiko, Choryu and Riko escape Eiganjo Castle but are separated and tricked into the kitsune village by Sharp-Ear.
events.quote: They manage to leave the castle

events.summary: Toshi follows nezumi, overhears their soratami deal, and is chased by soratami.
events.quote: thus the soratami start chasing him to silence him

events.summary: Hidetsugu directs Toshi to the budoka monks, and Toshi leaves for Jukai with Kobo.
events.quote: So he leaves for the forest of Jukai with Hidetsugu's apprentice Kobo

events.summary: Both groups are captured by orochi in Jukai; Toshi escapes, finds Kobo dead, and rescues Michiko from sacrifice.
events.quote: Toshi rescues Michiko who is going to be sacrificed by the Myojin of Life's Web to stop the war.

events.summary: In a cave Toshi meets Mochi and the Myojin of Night's Reach, who offers him power; he initially refuses.
Kitsune and orochi battle outside the cave; Toshi kills the orochi and, blessed by the Myojin of Night's Reach, unsummons the Myojin of Life's Web.
Toshi reveals Choryu killed Kobo and sends him flying away; Toshi escapes in mist.
events.quote: Toshi reveals that it was Choryu , not the orochi, who has killed Kobo

events.summary: Choryu lands in Shinka and Hidetsugu tortures him for Kobo's murder.
events.quote: he is there to answer for Kobo's murder

relations.quote: Michiko , daughter of the warlord Konda
Toshi reveals that it was Choryu , not the orochi, who has killed Kobo
he has promised to work for her
with the help of her friends, Choryu and Riko
